verdict.rationale: Alma documents its own portal where clients complete online questionnaires. It also describes a technology-enabled system that keeps cases moving with visibility at every step, which suggests structured intake rather than email. Document uploads, evidence checklists and automated reminders are never described explicitly. Missing for 10: documented document/evidence upload workflow, evidence checklists, automated reminders, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments
